create_passthrough_logging_handler: create a base passthrough logging handler for an LLM provider that transforms responses and generates standard logging objects
transform_llm_passthrough_response: transform an LLM provider passthrough response to OpenAI format and generate a standard logging payload
build_complete_streaming_response: build a complete streaming response from raw chunks collected from a passthrough LLM endpoint
handle_logging_llm_collected_chunks: handle logging for LLM collected streaming chunks by building a complete response and creating a standard logging object
get_user_from_metadata: get the end user ID from the passthrough logging request body metadata
